void emit(string text)
    println(text)

bool includes_text(string[] items, string value)
    for item := items[]
        if item == value
            return true
    return false

string[] merge_names(string[] first, string[] second)
    result := first
    for item := second[]
        if not includes_text(result, item)
            result = result.append(item)
    return result.sorted()

string[] without_name(string[] items, string value)
    return [for item := items[] if item != value then item]

string[] split_words(string text)
    return [for item := text.split(" ")[] if item != "" then item]

bool macro_name(string text)
    if text == "" or not "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ".contains(text[0])
        return false
    for: i < #text
        if not "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_".contains(text[i])
            return false
    return true

bool decimal_digits(string text)
    if text == ""
        return false
    for: i < #text
        if not "0123456789".contains(text[i])
            return false
    return true

bool reserved_name(string text)
    return includes_text(["S", "K", "I", "NORMAL", "APPLICATIVE", "CBN", "CBV"], text)

string sequence_name(nat index)
    letter := "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"[index % 26]
    return letter + (if index < 26 then "" else string(index / 26))

class TermNode(nat kind, text := "", nat number := 0, nat left := 0, nat right := 0)
class ReductionStep(bool found, nat term_id, kind := "")
class Outcome(bool success, nat term_id, nat steps)
class Closure(nat code, nat[] environment_ids)

class Arena()
    TermNode[] nodes := []
    string[][] free_sets := []
    string[][] references := []
    nat[] sizes := []
    nat[] depths := []

    nat .add_node(TermNode node)
        result := #nodes
        string[] free_names := []
        string[] macro_refs := []
        nat size := 1
        nat depth := 1
        if node.kind == 0
            free_names = [node.text]
        elif node.kind == 1
            macro_refs = [node.text]
        elif node.kind == 3 or node.kind == 7
            free_names = if node.kind == 3 then without_name(free_sets[node.left], node.text) else free_sets[node.left]
            macro_refs = references[node.left]
            size += sizes[node.left]
            depth += depths[node.left]
        elif node.kind == 4
            free_names = merge_names(free_sets[node.left], free_sets[node.right])
            macro_refs = references[node.left].concat(references[node.right])
            size += sizes[node.left] + sizes[node.right]
            depth += if depths[node.left] > depths[node.right] then depths[node.left] else depths[node.right]
        nodes = nodes.append(node)
        free_sets = free_sets.append(free_names)
        references = references.append(macro_refs)
        sizes = sizes.append(size)
        depths = depths.append(depth)
        return result

    nat .variable(string name)
        return .add_node(TermNode(0, name))

    nat .abstraction(string name, nat body)
        return .add_node(TermNode(3, name, left = body))

    nat .application(nat function_id, nat argument_id)
        return .add_node(TermNode(4, left = function_id, right = argument_id))

    nat .apply_all(nat head, nat[] arguments)
        result := head
        for argument := arguments[]
            result = .application(result, argument)
        return result

    string printed(nat term_id, at_end := true)
        node := nodes[term_id]
        if node.kind == 0 or node.kind == 1 or node.kind == 5
            return node.text
        if node.kind == 2
            return "#{node.number}"
        if node.kind == 6
            return string(node.number)
        if node.kind == 3
            string[] names := []
            current := term_id
            while nodes[current].kind == 3
                names = names.append(nodes[current].text)
                current = nodes[current].left
            string text := "\" + names.join(" ") + ". " + printed(current)
            return if at_end then text else "(" + text + ")"
        if node.kind == 7
            string text := "\" + printed(node.left)
            return if at_end then text else "(" + text + ")"
        string left_text := if nodes[node.left].kind == 3 or nodes[node.left].kind == 7 then "(" + printed(node.left) + ")" else printed(node.left, false)
        string right_text := if nodes[node.right].kind == 4 then "(" + printed(node.right) + ")" else printed(node.right, at_end)
        return left_text + " " + right_text

    nat .numeral(nat value)
        nat body := .variable("x")
        nat function_id := .variable("f")
        for: i < value
            body = .application(function_id, body)
        body = .abstraction("x", body)
        return .abstraction("f", body)

    nat .substitute(nat term_id, string name, nat value_id)
        if not includes_text(free_sets[term_id], name)
            return term_id
        node := nodes[term_id]
        if node.kind == 0
            return if node.text == name then value_id else term_id
        if node.kind == 4
            nat first := .substitute(node.left, name, value_id)
            nat second := .substitute(node.right, name, value_id)
            return .application(first, second)
        if node.kind != 3 or node.text == name or not includes_text(free_sets[node.left], name)
            return term_id
        if not includes_text(free_sets[value_id], node.text)
            nat body := .substitute(node.left, name, value_id)
            return .abstraction(node.text, body)
        base := node.text
        while #base > 0 and "0123456789".contains(base[#base - 1])
            base = base[:<#base - 1]
        nat suffix := 1
        fresh := base + string(suffix)
        while includes_text(free_sets[value_id], fresh) or includes_text(free_sets[node.left], fresh)
            suffix += 1
            fresh = base + string(suffix)
        nat replacement := .variable(fresh)
        nat renamed := .substitute(node.left, node.text, replacement)
        nat body := .substitute(renamed, name, value_id)
        return .abstraction(fresh, body)

    nat .to_db(nat term_id, string[] bound := [])
        node := nodes[term_id]
        if node.kind == 0
            for: i < #bound
                if bound[i] == node.text
                    return .add_node(TermNode(6, number = i))
            return term_id
        if node.kind == 3
            nat body := .to_db(node.left, [node.text].concat(bound))
            return .add_node(TermNode(7, left = body))
        if node.kind == 4
            nat first := .to_db(node.left, bound)
            nat second := .to_db(node.right, bound)
            return .application(first, second)
        return term_id

    nat .rename_db(nat term_id, string[] excluded, string[] bound, nat &counter)
        node := nodes[term_id]
        if node.kind == 6
            return .variable(bound[node.number])
        if node.kind == 7
            name := sequence_name(counter)
            counter += 1
            while includes_text(excluded, name)
                name = sequence_name(counter)
                counter += 1
            nat body := .rename_db(node.left, excluded, [name].concat(bound), &counter)
            return .abstraction(name, body)
        if node.kind == 4
            nat first := .rename_db(node.left, excluded, bound, &counter)
            nat second := .rename_db(node.right, excluded, bound, &counter)
            return .application(first, second)
        return term_id

    nat .from_db(nat term_id)
        nat counter := 0
        excluded := free_sets[term_id]
        return .rename_db(term_id, excluded, [], &counter)

    nat .canonical(nat term_id)
        nat converted := .to_db(term_id)
        return .from_db(converted)

    bool eta_redex(nat term_id)
        node := nodes[term_id]
        if node.kind != 3
            return false
        body := nodes[node.left]
        if body.kind != 4
            return false
        argument := nodes[body.right]
        return argument.kind == 0 and argument.text == node.text and not includes_text(free_sets[body.left], node.text)

    ReductionStep .one_step(nat term_id, string strategy, bool eta_enabled)
        node := nodes[term_id]
        if node.kind == 4
            first := nodes[node.left]
            if first.kind == 3 and (strategy == "NORMAL" or strategy == "CBN")
                return ReductionStep(true, .substitute(first.left, first.text, node.right), "beta")
            ReductionStep changed := .one_step(node.left, strategy, eta_enabled)
            if changed.found
                return ReductionStep(true, .application(changed.term_id, node.right), changed.kind)
            if strategy != "CBN"
                changed = .one_step(node.right, strategy, eta_enabled)
                if changed.found
                    return ReductionStep(true, .application(node.left, changed.term_id), changed.kind)
            argument_kind := nodes[node.right].kind
            if first.kind == 3 and (strategy == "APPLICATIVE" or argument_kind == 0 or argument_kind == 3)
                return ReductionStep(true, .substitute(first.left, first.text, node.right), "beta")
        elif node.kind == 3 and (strategy == "NORMAL" or strategy == "APPLICATIVE")
            contractible := eta_enabled and eta_redex(term_id)
            if contractible and strategy == "NORMAL"
                return ReductionStep(true, nodes[node.left].left, "eta")
            ReductionStep changed := .one_step(node.left, strategy, eta_enabled)
            if changed.found
                return ReductionStep(true, .abstraction(node.text, changed.term_id), changed.kind)
            if contractible
                return ReductionStep(true, nodes[node.left].left, "eta")
        return ReductionStep(false, term_id)

    nat .abstract_ski(string name, nat term_id)
        node := nodes[term_id]
        if not includes_text(free_sets[term_id], name)
            nat constant := .add_node(TermNode(5, "K"))
            return .application(constant, term_id)
        if node.kind == 0 and node.text == name
            return .add_node(TermNode(5, "I"))
        argument := nodes[node.right]
        if argument.kind == 0 and argument.text == name and not includes_text(free_sets[node.left], name)
            return node.left
        nat first := .abstract_ski(name, node.left)
        nat second := .abstract_ski(name, node.right)
        nat constant := .add_node(TermNode(5, "S"))
        first = .application(constant, first)
        return .application(first, second)

    nat .to_ski(nat term_id)
        node := nodes[term_id]
        if node.kind == 3
            nat body := .to_ski(node.left)
            return .abstract_ski(node.text, body)
        if node.kind == 4
            nat first := .to_ski(node.left)
            nat second := .to_ski(node.right)
            return .application(first, second)
        return term_id

    ReductionStep .ski_step(nat term_id)
        head := term_id
        nat[] arguments := []
        while nodes[head].kind == 4
            arguments = [nodes[head].right].concat(arguments)
            head = nodes[head].left
        node := nodes[head]
        if node.kind == 5
            if node.text == "I" and #arguments >= 1
                return ReductionStep(true, .apply_all(arguments[0], arguments[1:]), "I")
            if node.text == "K" and #arguments >= 2
                return ReductionStep(true, .apply_all(arguments[0], arguments[2:]), "K")
            if node.text == "S" and #arguments >= 3
                nat first := .application(arguments[0], arguments[2])
                nat second := .application(arguments[1], arguments[2])
                nat body := .application(first, second)
                return ReductionStep(true, .apply_all(body, arguments[3:]), "S")
        for: i < #arguments
            ReductionStep changed := .ski_step(arguments[i])
            if changed.found
                arguments[i] = changed.term_id
                return ReductionStep(true, .apply_all(head, arguments), changed.kind)
        return ReductionStep(false, term_id)

    string .church_value(nat term_id)
        node := nodes[term_id]
        if node.kind == 3 and nodes[node.left].kind == 3
            inner := nodes[node.left]
            body := inner.left
            nat count := 0
            while nodes[body].kind == 4
                function_node := nodes[nodes[body].left]
                if function_node.kind != 0 or function_node.text != node.text
                    break
                body = nodes[body].right
                count += 1
            if nodes[body].kind == 0 and nodes[body].text == inner.text
                return string(count)
            innermost := nodes[inner.left]
            if innermost.kind == 0 and innermost.text == node.text
                return "true"
        if node.kind == 3
            body := nodes[node.left]
            if body.kind == 4 and nodes[body.left].kind == 4
                first_application := nodes[body.left]
                head := nodes[first_application.left]
                first := first_application.right
                second := body.right
                if head.kind == 0 and head.text == node.text and not includes_text(free_sets[first], node.text) and not includes_text(free_sets[second], node.text)
                    string first_text := .church_value(first)
                    string second_text := .church_value(second)
                    return "(" + first_text + ", " + second_text + ")"
        nat renamed := .canonical(term_id)
        return printed(renamed)

    nat .read_back(nat term_id, Closure[] closures, nat[] environment_ids, nat binders := 0)
        current := term_id
        active_environment := environment_ids
        bound_count := binders
        node := nodes[current]
        while node.kind == 6 and node.number >= bound_count
            saved := closures[active_environment[node.number - bound_count]]
            current = saved.code
            active_environment = saved.environment_ids
            bound_count = 0
            node = nodes[current]
        if node.kind == 7
            nat body := .read_back(node.left, closures, active_environment, bound_count + 1)
            return .add_node(TermNode(7, left = body))
        if node.kind == 4
            nat first := .read_back(node.left, closures, active_environment, bound_count)
            nat second := .read_back(node.right, closures, active_environment, bound_count)
            return .application(first, second)
        return current

nat copy_term(Arena source, Arena &target, nat term_id, map<nat, nat> &memo)
    match memo.get(term_id)
        nat cached
            return cached
        none
            void
    node := source.nodes[term_id]
    if node.kind == 3 or node.kind == 7 or node.kind == 4
        node.left = copy_term(source, &target, node.left, &memo)
    if node.kind == 4
        node.right = copy_term(source, &target, node.right, &memo)
    result := .target.add_node(node)
    .memo.set(term_id, result)
    return result

class Token(nat kind, string text, nat column)
class Reader(string source, nat first_column, nat end_column)
    Token[] tokens := []
    nat position := 0

    void | error .tokenize()
        nat at := 0
        while at < #source
            character := source[at]
            if character == " "
                at += 1
                continue
            start := at
            nat kind := 9
            if "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".contains(character)
                kind = 0
                while at < #source and "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789".contains(source[at])
                    at += 1
            elif "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ".contains(character)
                kind = 1
                while at < #source and "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_".contains(source[at])
                    at += 1
            elif character == "#" and at + 1 < #source and "0123456789".contains(source[at + 1])
                kind = 2
                at += 1
                while at < #source and "0123456789".contains(source[at])
                    at += 1
            else
                symbols := ["\", ".", "(", ")", "=", ";"]
                for: i < #symbols
                    if symbols[i] == character
                        kind = i + 3
                if kind == 9
                    return error("column {first_column + at}: unexpected character '" + character + "'")
                at += 1
            tokens = tokens.append(Token(kind, source[start:<at], first_column + start))
        tokens = tokens.append(Token(9, "", end_column))
        return void

    Token peek()
        return tokens[position]

    Token .take_token()
        result := tokens[position]
        position += 1
        return result

    Token | error .expect(nat kind)
        Token token := peek()
        if token.kind != kind
            descriptions := ["variable", "macro name", "", "", "'.'", "", "')'", "'='", "';'"]
            return error("column {token.column}: expected " + descriptions[kind])
        return .take_token()

    void | error finish()
        Token token := peek()
        if token.kind != 9
            return error("column {token.column}: unexpected '" + token.text + "'")
        return void

    nat | error .read_term(Arena &arena)
        nat[] elements := []
        while peek().kind == 0 or peek().kind == 1 or peek().kind == 2 or peek().kind == 5
            Token token := .take_token()
            nat element := 0
            if token.kind == 0
                element = .arena.variable(token.text)
            elif token.kind == 1
                element = .arena.add_node(TermNode(1, token.text))
            elif token.kind == 2
                element = .arena.add_node(TermNode(2, number = nat(token.text[1:])))
            else
                element = try .read_term(&arena)
                try .expect(6)
            elements = elements.append(element)
        if peek().kind == 3
            .take_token()
            Token first := try .expect(0)
            names := [first.text]
            while peek().kind == 0
                token := .take_token()
                names = names.append(token.text)
            try .expect(4)
            nat body := try .read_term(&arena)
            for name := names[::-1][]
                body = .arena.abstraction(name, body)
            elements = elements.append(body)
        if #elements == 0
            return error("column {peek().column}: expected term")
        return .arena.apply_all(elements[0], elements[1:])

class TypeNode(arrow := false, nat left := 0, nat right := 0)
class Typer()
    TypeNode[] type_nodes := []
    int[] links := []

    nat .fresh()
        result := #type_nodes
        type_nodes = type_nodes.append(TypeNode())
        links = links.append(-1)
        return result

    nat .function_type(nat domain, nat codomain)
        result := #type_nodes
        type_nodes = type_nodes.append(TypeNode(true, domain, codomain))
        links = links.append(-1)
        return result

    nat resolve(nat type_id)
        current := type_id
        while not type_nodes[current].arrow and links[current] >= 0
            current = nat(links[current])
        return current

    bool occurs(nat variable_id, nat type_id)
        nat current := resolve(type_id)
        node := type_nodes[current]
        return if node.arrow then occurs(variable_id, node.left) or occurs(variable_id, node.right) else variable_id == current

    void | error .unify(nat first, nat second)
        nat a := resolve(first)
        nat b := resolve(second)
        if not type_nodes[a].arrow
            if a != b
                if occurs(a, b)
                    return error("not typable")
                links[a] = int(b)
        elif not type_nodes[b].arrow
            try .unify(b, a)
        else
            try .unify(type_nodes[a].left, type_nodes[b].left)
            try .unify(type_nodes[a].right, type_nodes[b].right)
        return void

    nat | error .infer(Arena source, nat term_id, map<string, nat> scope)
        node := source.nodes[term_id]
        if node.kind == 0
            match scope.get(node.text)
                nat type_id
                    return type_id
                none
                    return error("not typable")
        if node.kind == 3
            nat parameter := .fresh()
            .scope.set(node.text, parameter)
            nat body := try .infer(source, node.left, scope)
            return .function_type(parameter, body)
        nat function_id := try .infer(source, node.left, scope)
        nat result := .fresh()
        nat argument_id := try .infer(source, node.right, scope)
        nat arrow_id := .function_type(argument_id, result)
        try .unify(function_id, arrow_id)
        return result

    string .render(nat type_id, map<nat, string> &names)
        nat current := resolve(type_id)
        node := type_nodes[current]
        if not node.arrow
            match names.get(current)
                string existing
                    return existing
                none
                    name := sequence_name(#names.keys())
                    .names.set(current, name)
                    return name
        string domain := .render(node.left, &names)
        if type_nodes[resolve(node.left)].arrow
            domain = "(" + domain + ")"
        string codomain := .render(node.right, &names)
        return domain + " -> " + codomain

class Workbench()
    arena := Arena()
    macros := map<string, nat>()
    expansion_cache := map<nat, nat>()
    show_steps := false
    eta_mode := false
    nat step_limit := 10000

    void .initialize()
        keys := ["S", "K", "I"]
        bodies := ["\x y z. x z (y z)", "\x y. x", "\x. x"]
        for: i < #keys
            reader := Reader(bodies[i], 1, #bodies[i] + 1)
            .reader.tokenize()
            term_id := .reader.read_term(&arena)
            .macros.set(keys[i], term_id)

    void .compact()
        retained := Arena()
        map<nat, nat> memo
        map<string, nat> updated
        for key := macros.keys().sorted()[]
            match macros.get(key)
                nat body
                    copied := copy_term(arena, &retained, body, &memo)
                    .updated.set(key, copied)
                none
                    void
        arena = retained
        macros = updated
        expansion_cache = map<nat, nat>()

    string[] user_names()
        return [for key := macros.keys().sorted()[] if key != "S" and key != "K" and key != "I" then key]

    bool depends_on(string reference, string target)
        pending := [reference]
        string[] visited := []
        while #pending != 0
            name := pending[-1]
            pending = pending[:<#pending - 1]
            if includes_text(visited, name)
                continue
            visited = visited.append(name)
            if name == "S" or name == "K" or name == "I"
                continue
            match macros.get(name)
                nat body
                    for child := arena.references[body][]
                        if child == target
                            return true
                        if not includes_text(visited, child)
                            pending = pending.append(child)
                none
                    void
        return false

    nat | error .expand(nat term_id)
        match expansion_cache.get(term_id)
            nat cached
                return cached
            none
                void
        TermNode node := arena.nodes[term_id]
        result := term_id
        if node.kind == 1
            match macros.get(node.text)
                nat body
                    result = try .expand(body)
                none
                    return error("unbound macro " + node.text)
        elif node.kind == 2
            result = .arena.numeral(node.number)
        elif node.kind == 3
            nat body := try .expand(node.left)
            result = .arena.abstraction(node.text, body)
        elif node.kind == 4
            nat first := try .expand(node.left)
            nat second := try .expand(node.right)
            result = .arena.application(first, second)
        .expansion_cache.set(term_id, result)
        return result

    Outcome .normalize(nat term_id, strategy := "NORMAL", use_eta := false, display := false, ski := false)
        current := term_id
        nat count := 0
        while true
            ReductionStep next := if ski then .arena.ski_step(current) else .arena.one_step(current, strategy, use_eta)
            if not next.found
                return Outcome(true, current, count)
            if count == step_limit
                return Outcome(false, current, count)
            current = next.term_id
            count += 1
            if display
                emit("step {count} (" + next.kind + "): " + arena.printed(current))

    string no_normal_form()
        return "no normal form within {step_limit} steps"

    void .report_outcome(Outcome result, bool canonical_form)
        if not result.success
            emit(no_normal_form())
        else
            nat id := if canonical_form then .arena.canonical(result.term_id) else result.term_id
            emit("result: " + arena.printed(id) + " (steps: {result.steps})")

    bool .alpha_equal(nat first, nat second)
        nat a := .arena.to_db(first)
        nat b := .arena.to_db(second)
        return arena.printed(a) == arena.printed(b)

    string principal_type(nat term_id)
        typer := Typer()
        map<string, nat> scope
        for name := arena.free_sets[term_id][]
            type_id := .typer.fresh()
            .scope.set(name, type_id)
        match .typer.infer(arena, term_id, scope)
            nat type_id
                map<nat, string> names
                return .typer.render(type_id, &names)
            error failure
                return "not typable"

    void .run_kam(nat term_id)
        nat code := .arena.to_db(term_id)
        Closure[] closures := []
        nat[] environment_ids := []
        nat[] pending_ids := []
        nat count := 0
        while true
            TermNode node := arena.nodes[code]
            if node.kind == 0 or (node.kind == 7 and #pending_ids == 0)
                break
            if count == step_limit
                emit("no result within {step_limit} transitions")
                return
            kind := ""
            if node.kind == 4
                pending_ids = pending_ids.append(#closures)
                closures = closures.append(Closure(node.right, environment_ids))
                code = node.left
                kind = "push"
            elif node.kind == 7
                closure_id := pending_ids[-1]
                pending_ids = pending_ids[:<#pending_ids - 1]
                environment_ids = [closure_id].concat(environment_ids)
                code = node.left
                kind = "grab"
            else
                saved := closures[environment_ids[node.number]]
                code = saved.code
                environment_ids = saved.environment_ids
                kind = "access"
            count += 1
            if show_steps
                emit("step {count} (" + kind + "): " + arena.printed(code) + " [env {#environment_ids}, stack {#pending_ids}]")
        nat result := .arena.read_back(code, closures, environment_ids)
        for: #pending_ids > i >= 0
            saved := closures[pending_ids[i]]
            nat argument := .arena.read_back(saved.code, closures, saved.environment_ids)
            result = .arena.application(result, argument)
        result = .arena.from_db(result)
        emit("result: " + arena.printed(result) + " (transitions: {count})")

    void | error .word_command(string command, string argument)
        words := split_words(argument)
        if command == "steps" or command == "eta"
            if #words != 1 or (words[0] != "on" and words[0] != "off")
                return error("bad argument")
            if command == "steps"
                show_steps = words[0] == "on"
            else
                eta_mode = words[0] == "on"
        elif command == "limit"
            if #words != 1 or #words[0] > 5 or not decimal_digits(words[0])
                return error("bad argument")
            value := nat(words[0])
            if value < 1 or value > 10000
                return error("bad argument")
            step_limit = value
        elif command == "macros"
            if #words > 0
                return error("bad argument")
            string[] names := user_names()
            if #names == 0
                emit("(none)")
            for name := names[]
                match macros.get(name)
                    nat body
                        emit(name + " = " + arena.printed(body))
                    none
                        void
        else
            if #words != 1 or not macro_name(words[0])
                return error("bad argument")
            key := words[0]
            if reserved_name(key)
                return error("reserved name " + key)
            match macros.get(key)
                nat body
                    void
                none
                    return error("unbound macro " + key)
            for other := user_names()[]
                match macros.get(other)
                    nat body
                        if includes_text(arena.references[body], key)
                            return error(key + " is used by " + other)
                    none
                        void
            .macros.remove(key)
            emit("removed " + key)
        return void

    void | error .process_line(string line)
        .compact()
        split := #line
        match line.find(" ")
            nat at
                split = at
            none
                void
        command := line[:<split]
        argument := if split < #line then line[split + 1:] else ""
        if includes_text(["unlet", "macros", "steps", "eta", "limit"], command)
            return .word_command(command, argument)
        if not includes_text(["let", "expand", "subst", "reduce", "equal", "alpha", "debruijn", "fv", "size", "depth", "type", "church", "ski", "skireduce", "kam"], command)
            return error("unknown command " + command)
        reader := Reader(argument, #command + 2, #line + 1)
        try .reader.tokenize()
        expansion_cache = map<nat, nat>()
        if command == "let"
            key := try .reader.expect(1)
            try .reader.expect(7)
            body := try .reader.read_term(&arena)
            try reader.finish()
            if reserved_name(key.text)
                return error("reserved name " + key.text)
            for reference := arena.references[body][]
                if reference == key.text or depends_on(reference, key.text)
                    return error("recursive definition of " + key.text)
                match macros.get(reference)
                    nat existing
                        void
                    none
                        return error("unbound macro " + reference)
            if #arena.free_sets[body] > 0
                return error("free variable " + arena.free_sets[body][0] + " in definition of " + key.text)
            existed := false
            match macros.get(key.text)
                nat existing
                    existed = true
                none
                    void
            .macros.set(key.text, body)
            emit((if existed then "redefined " else "defined ") + key.text)
            return
        if command == "subst"
            name := try .reader.expect(0)
            try .reader.expect(7)
            value_id := try .reader.read_term(&arena)
            try .reader.expect(8)
            target := try .reader.read_term(&arena)
            try reader.finish()
            value_id = try .expand(value_id)
            target = try .expand(target)
            nat result := .arena.substitute(target, name.text, value_id)
            emit(arena.printed(result))
            return
        strategy := "NORMAL"
        if command == "reduce" and reader.peek().kind == 1 and includes_text(["NORMAL", "APPLICATIVE", "CBN", "CBV"], reader.peek().text)
            token := .reader.take_token()
            strategy = token.text
        first := try .reader.read_term(&arena)
        if command == "equal" or command == "alpha"
            try .reader.expect(8)
            second := try .reader.read_term(&arena)
            try reader.finish()
            first = try .expand(first)
            second = try .expand(second)
            if command == "alpha"
                emit(if .alpha_equal(first, second) then "yes" else "no")
            else
                Outcome a := .normalize(first, use_eta = eta_mode)
                Outcome b := .normalize(second, use_eta = eta_mode)
                emit(if not a.success or not b.success then "unknown" else (if .alpha_equal(a.term_id, b.term_id) then "yes" else "no"))
            return
        try reader.finish()
        first = try .expand(first)
        if command == "expand"
            emit(arena.printed(first))
        elif command == "reduce"
            Outcome result := .normalize(first, strategy, eta_mode, show_steps)
            .report_outcome(result, true)
        elif command == "debruijn"
            nat converted := .arena.to_db(first)
            emit(arena.printed(converted))
        elif command == "fv"
            string[] names := arena.free_sets[first]
            emit(if #names == 0 then "(none)" else names.join(" "))
        elif command == "size"
            emit(string(arena.sizes[first]))
        elif command == "depth"
            emit(string(arena.depths[first]))
        elif command == "type"
            emit(principal_type(first))
        elif command == "church"
            Outcome result := .normalize(first)
            if not result.success
                emit(no_normal_form())
            else
                nat renamed := .arena.canonical(result.term_id)
                emit(.arena.church_value(renamed))
        elif command == "ski" or command == "skireduce"
            nat converted := .arena.to_ski(first)
            if command == "ski"
                emit(arena.printed(converted))
            else
                Outcome result := .normalize(converted, display = show_steps, ski = true)
                .report_outcome(result, false)
        else
            .run_kam(first)
        return void

void read_commands()
    workbench := Workbench()
    .workbench.initialize()
    line := ""
    while true
        match scan(&line)
            void
                void
            error failure
                break
        if line == "quit"
            break
        if line == "" or line.starts_with("--")
            continue
        match .workbench.process_line(line)
            void
                void
            error failure
                emit("error: " + failure.message)

read_commands()
